releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.23

- Stops repeated automatic reinstalls by reading Bike Sync's version from the installed app rather than an obsolete hard-coded value.
- Rejects any downloaded app whose embedded version is not both newer and identical to the signed update manifest.
- Makes publisher installs race-safe by pausing the keep-running supervisor and relaunching only after the public update feed is current.
- Relocates the duplicate updater backups created by the defect out of Applications without deleting them.
- Retains the completed VeloViewer Top 20 index, Top 10 baseline, starred weather segments, and reviewed-case state from 2.4.22.
